name: Can I replace only a portion of a damaged exterior window sill?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace only a portion of a damaged exterior window sill?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it might seem possible to replace only a damaged section of an exterior window sill, we generally recommend full sill replacement when damage is significant. Patching a portion can be a temporary fix, but often the underlying cause of the damage (like water intrusion) may affect other parts of the sill or frame, leading to future problems. A full replacement ensures a complete and lasting solution, addressing potential hidden damage and providing a consistent aesthetic. This approach offers a practical tradeoff: a slightly larger initial project for greater long-term durability and peace of mind.
acceptedAnswer.description: We typically recommend full sill replacement over partial repairs to ensure a lasting solution and address hidden damage.
